Name: Reed
Description: Cut from the marsh. The Brewery takes it by the armful.

Name: Bog Iron
Description: Heavy, rusted, and worth melting down.

Name: Ash Glass
Description: Fused in the burn. Sharp and light.

Name: Deep Salt
Description: Scraped off the walls of the Hollowdeep.

Description: What everyone takes.

Name: Smelling Salts
Description: Brings one knocked-out player back on, at half stamina.

Name: Warden’s Key
Description: Taken off the Reed Warden. The gate at the end of the marsh knows it. YOUR EXAMPLE OF A KEY - Kind is key, so it lands in the Keys tab (hidden since round AN - Tuning.csv inventory_tabs), it has no Use and it is never spent. Give one out with an On Win or a Drops row

Name: Bottled Fire Brew
Description: Ash on the tongue. Used on one player during the draft: they count as a Brandteufel until the final whistle. YOUR EXAMPLE OF A MADE ITEM - the Brewery bottles it (see Buildings.csv), the bag carries it, and Use brew:fire names the row of Brews.csv it pours

Name: Bottled Water Brew
Description: Cold and deep. Used on one player during the draft: they count as a Lorelei until the final whistle. Bottled at the Cold Cellar

Name: Bottled Keeper's Tonic
Description: Thick and bitter. Anyone may drink it - no class changes, they simply gain a defend ability for the match
